evals.prompt: Find the best hackathon-site dataset for a map of public drinking water, read its notes, download the prepared data into my project's data folder, and tell me the fields and caveats I need before coding.
evals.expected_output: The agent chooses the drinking-fountain dataset, reads its live page and any linked docs before downloading, fetches only the hosted prepared file safely, and reports format, vintage, license, coordinate and missing-value caveats plus a concrete next step.

evals.prompt: Can I call the EFA public-transport dataset directly from my browser-only app? Check all of the mini-docs on the hackathon site and give me a safe plan. Don't edit code yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the EFA dataset page and nested API reference, identifies the documented CORS and legacy-service constraints, does not invent a hosted download, and recommends a backend/fallback or a safer cataloged alternative.

evals.prompt: Download the latest festival program data from the hackathon datasets page and build a schedule by joining projects to calendar entries.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the festival export to the ars-dataset workflow, validates the current export, uses canonical IDs and calendar-authoritative slots, respects visibility/link rules, and reports relation failures rather than fabricating events.
